Original 1990s shonen battle-anime fighting-game artwork, with the explosive visual energy and hand-painted cel look of Dragon Ball Z era action animation. Angular expressive eyes and brows, bold economical black ink, sculpted two-tone cel shadows, pronounced but believable athletic anatomy, sharp fabric folds, dramatic foreshortening, bright golden highlights and electric cyan or magenta energy. Original cast only: preserve each supplied person's recognizable face, body build, hairstyle silhouette, clothing and accessories. Increase pointed hair clumps only where compatible with that person; do not replace their hair, outfit or identity with an existing anime character. Strong grounded fighting stances, powerful clear action silhouettes. No copied franchise characters, costumes, symbols or logos. No extra fingers, duplicated props, lettering or watermarks.
CHARACTER: The node conductor. Short dark hair beneath a black cap, large black rectangular glasses, cream graphic T-shirt with yellow and black blocks, dark trousers, silver chain and belt chain. A lively open-hand guard and confident grin. Complete unseen footwear as black high-top sneakers. The fighting persona and powers are fictional; preserve visible reference features without copying name tags or small shirt lettering.
SIGNATURE SPECIAL MOVE: Node Burst: Allyson links bright yellow rectangular energy nodes between both open palms, then thrusts forward to release a compact connected-node projectile toward the right. Keep the shape close to the hands in the sprite; the separate game projectile continues the burst.
Use the supplied photo as the visible appearance reference for its main foreground subject; ignore bystanders and background. Translate that person into an original anime fighter. Create one full-body character model reference, entire head and shoes visible, three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, neutral fighting stance. Complete unseen clothing details according to the character description. This design is the identity reference for every later asset. Flat uniform chroma green background RGB(0,255,0), no gradient, no floor shadow, no green on the subject, no lettering, borders, watermark, props outside the silhouette or detached debris. All clothing, shoes, soles, skin and accessories are fully opaque in their specified non-green colors: NO green apparel, green footwear, green reflections or translucent green body parts. Chroma green belongs only outside the character. Leave ample clear green padding around the whole subject. Use a solid clean ink silhouette, without a colored outline fringe. Accessories remain attached to the character; exactly one of each visible accessory.
Create the requested original game art. Follow the layout and reference identity precisely.

# Start here: source photo to first anime fighter

CLOUD ONLY. This graph contains 1 paid image-generation node(s). Running those nodes consumes Comfy credits. Source Load Image and Save nodes are local file operations. No generation is triggered by creating or building these files.

Source photos feed anime model references; those outputs feed all derived art for consistent identity.

Outputs: ComfyUI/output/hackathon/. Import with npm run import:assets -- --from <output-folder>, then npm run build. Inspect pose sheets and anchors before release. Do not put credentials in this workflow.
